title: The PM/dev handoff isn't what it used to be
description: The PM to dev handoff used to mean a document nobody loved reading and a long wait to find out if the idea actually worked. When agents can take a vague idea to a working pull request in a day, the whole loop changes. This session is about what that means for how product and engineering work together now and what a faster, prototype-first culture actually looks like on a team shipping weekly.
location: Gateway Pavilion, Level 1, Build Broadcast Stage
